item.note: Given their coherent stylistic features, in particular paleographical features and the placing of the red volume letter, the volumes listed can be identified as a coherent set, of which, however, several volumes are missing. It is possible that some of the other 'bum volumes were intended as later replacement of these missing volumes, this, however, is highly speculative. The beginning and final folios of this set contained illuminations but most of these are missing. Vol. ka: missing folios: 1-7, 9-49, 51-88, 184; folio number jumps from 238 to 249 as indicated on f.238. Vol. kha: missing folios: 2-16, 50; f.346 is the last folio, the rest is missing. Vol. ga: Volume is missing completely. Vol. nga: Volume is missing completely. Vol. ca: In this volume, the folios were renumbered and seem to be somewhat out of order. The folio numbers recorded are given according to the new foliation. Missing folios: 1-2, 10, 12-34, 51-52, 100-102, 197, 247-269, 271-275, 301-304, 306-307, 312-314, 317, 319, 332; after f.58, the folio count jumps back to f.56; after f.60, the folio count jumps ahead to f.76, as stated on f.60; after f.199, the folio count jumps ahead to f.205, as stated on f.199; after f.234, the folio count jumps ahead to f.213, as stated on f.234; the last folio of the volume feature brief dedicatory remark: yon mchod thog grangs sems can thams cad ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las grol nas /_mtho ris dang thar pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig/_kra shis par gyur cig/_//_dge slong rdo rje'i thugs dgongs 'grub //_dge'o //he//. Vol. cha: missing folios: 1-3, 5-6, 11-13, 23-44, 46, 51-61, 63-74, 76-81, 84-92, 107, 109, 113-123, 125-126, 129, 131-132, 256; f.338 is the last folio, the rest is missing. Vol. ja: Volume is missing completely. Vol. nya: missing folios: 1-12, 14-15, 56; f.326 is the last folio, the rest is missing. Vol. ta: Volume is missing completely. Vol. tha: missing folios: 1-5, 11, 13, 17, 20, 22, 30, 33-51, 70, 91-97, 100, 149-156, 158-170, 172-190, 193-199, 211-230, 270-271, 281, 297, 322-330, 333-355; f.357 is the last folio, the rest is missing. Vol. da: missing folios: 1-3, 5-7; 199, f.357 is the last folio, the rest is missing. Vol. na: missing folios: 1-8, 334.Vol. pa: Volume is missing completely. item.note: This set of fourteen slightly younger 'bum volumes ('bum 2) is seemingly complete, but as the features of the individual volumes vary slightly, their belonging to the same set is only tentative. In particular, the volumes listed under 'bum 3 show similar feature, even though they are mostly shorter in size. Vol. ka: missing folios: 1-2?;f.2a provides information on the makers of the volume: yum 'di zhal gso'i mthun 'gyur mdzad mkhan//_zhab drung tshe bstan kyis dbu mdzad//_dbu sre dge slong mgon po dang //_shAk+ya'i dge slong tshe rings gsum gyis [?-?] dmar lha bde'i bka' dros dam pa'i chos la legs mdzas nas//_rgyu ma'i nor la snying po blangs phyir bzhengs 'di/bzhengs dge ba'i bsod nams kyi sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan bstan du [?-?]. However, it seems likely that f.1-2 were misplaced from a Pañcavimsatisahasrikaprajñaparamita volume, as stated on f.2b; foliation jumps from f.231 to f236 as stated on f.231; final folio features ye dharma hetu formula. Vol. kha: missing folios: 6. The final folio of the volume features the ye dharma hetu formula. Vol. ga: the last folio of this volume features a short dedicatory note: yon mchod kra shis par gyur cig //_he he //. Vol. nga: complete. Vol. ca: the last folio of this volume features a short dedicatory note: yon mchod kra shis par gyurd cig. Vol cha: complete. Vol. ja: this volume has images glued onto the first folio; missing folios: 254. Vol. nya: missing folio: 251; the last folio of the volume features the ye dharma hetu formula and a short dedicatory note: kra shis par shog //_dge'o /_he he //. Vol. ta: the last folio of the volume features short dedicatory note: kra shi par gyurd cig //. Vol. tha: the volume contains a title folio with a longer dedication that is perhaps not originally from this volume; the folios after f.310 are later replacements, several of these younger folios bear two folio numbers; it could be that the additional folios found in vol. 76, running number Dm83, match with these folios. Vol. da: the first folio has been replaced and carries a scribal note: yi ge pa ni bu chen mgon po he /_dge legs phel/. Vol. na: complete. Vol. pa: at the beginning of the volume are two dedication sheets, these are quite likely shifted from other volumes; the final folio features the ye dharma hetu formula. Vol. pha: quite likely the cover folio was shifted from another volume; from f.167 onward, the volume letter changes to a, which is often used in the final volume of a set; the final folio feature the ye dharma heut formular and a short dedicatory phrase: yon mchod kra shis par gyurd cig //.

One of four 'bum volumes ('bum 3), which cannot be clearly assigned to a set. They are similar in style to the volumes of 'bum 2, but mostly a bit smaller in size. Missing folios: 1-4, 35-38, 176, 189, 242-272, 274-275, 280-286. The final folio is f.290, the rest is missing.

One of four 'bum volumes ('bum 3), which cannot be clearly assigned to a set. They are similar in style to the volumes of 'bum 2, but mostly a bit smaller in size. Missing folios: 34-35, 56-58, 63, 65, 69-70, 219, 229-230, 244, 277, 331; it is further doubtful that f.1, which contains a longer dedication, originally belonged to this volume: The final folio is f.357, the rest is missing.

One of four 'bum volumes ('bum 3), which cannot be clearly assigned to a set. They are similar in style to the volumes of 'bum 2, but mostly a bit smaller in size. The first folio features a longer dedication but likely does not originally belong to this volume; missing folio: 2; the final folio is f.341, the rest is missing. At the end, further 19 folios (ff.311-329) of another volume tha are added. It could well be that these match with a replaced passage at the end of volume 69, running number Dm115.

item.note: Missing folios in volume ka: 2; in volume kha: 43; in volume ga: 318; in volume nga: 70b and 71a, 280b and 281a, 297b and 298a, 426; in volume ca: 191-199; in volume cha: 351; in volume ja: 300b and 301a; in volume nya: 52, 59, 68, 91b and 92a, 110b and 111a, 349b and 350a; in volume ta: 123b and 124a, 152b and 153a; in volume da: 36b and 37a, 179b and 180a, 328b and 329a, 336b and 337a; in volume na: 63, 448b and 449a. Further, the following anomalies were noted: In volume ga, the order of bam pos is incoherent; in volumes ca and cha, both bam po as well as chapter indications are in disorder; in volume ja, ten additional folios are attached at the end of the volume, but their location is unclear and their foliation was repeatedly changed; in volume nya, most folios after f. 201 feature one too many of the abbreviate strokes for hundreds; however, when the number is spelled out for the even hundreds (300, 400, 500) this mistake is corrected; in volume ta, foliation jumps from f. 402 to 503; obviously all later numbers must be corrected by a hundred; in volume da, several chapter indications are missing; in volume na, both bam po and chapter indications are in disorder. In general, all 'bum volumes show numerous signs of later textual emendation; the overall state of the collection is unclear, many bam po and especially chapter indications are missing, and if they are indicated their order is often confused. Compared to S, there is a general difference in that S has a consecutive bam po count, whereas in Z the bam po count newly begins with every volume. The volume number, dum bu, is often indicated with the bam po marker. The Stog version of 'bum lists 76 chapters and thus concurs with similar long versions as found in Hemis or Namgyal, etc., but it is different from the version with 72 chapters as listed in D as well as S or Ty. Further, the Shey 'bum section shows many traces of usage in ritual recitation. Along with other differences in style and layout, this suggests that this part was perhaps produced earlier and then incorporated in the latter collection.

item.note: The heterogeneous makeup of these twenty-three volumes reflects the consolidation of fragments from an undetermined number of distinct 'bum sets, resulting in composite, overlapping, and incomplete witnesses. Since the features of individual volumes vary, they cannot be assigned to specific sets with certainty. Vol. ka 2: the text is incomplete, stopping at f.326b. Vol. ka 3: f.124 is missing but text is complete; f.135 is missing; f.218 is missing but text is complete. Vol. kha 1: After f.10, numbering restarts with f.4 and continues. Vol. kha 2: ff.143 and 243 are missing but text is complete. Vol. ga 1: ff.302-305 are missing. Vol. cha 1: f.111 is missing. Vol. ja 1: Only one half of f.1 is extant, the folio having broken vertically through the middle; ff.322-334 bear additional, largely cancelled numbering: 333 (crossed out), 332, 331, 330, 329, and then 328-321 all crossed out. Vol. ja 2: 1b and 2a are missing. Vol. nya 1: f.77 is missing but text is complete. Vol. tha 1: f.89 is missing; f.239 is missing but text is complete. Vol. tha 2: f.179 is missing but text is complete; f.300 is missing. Vol. tha 3: ff.84 and 133 are missing but text is complete. Vol. pa 1: f.154 is missing but text is complete. Vol. pha 1: f.232 is missing. Vol. ba 1: f.79 (marked as vol. ba on the left margin) is followed by ff.80-88 (marked as vol. ba ha on the left margin) and then by f.88 (marked as vol. ba on the left margin); f.112 is missing but text is complete. Vol. A 1: ff.16-17 are missing but text is complete; f.324a features a short dedicatory note: yon mchod kra shis par gyurd cig.
